products.page.title: Products
products.page.description: Manage product content, pricing, publication, variants, stock, images, and option catalog.
products.searchPlaceholder: Search by product name or slug...
products.dialog.createDescription: Create the product as a draft, then configure variants, stock, images, and publication.
products.dialog.editDescription: Update product content, pricing, and catalog relationships.
products.form.slugDescription: Lowercase English letters, numbers, and single hyphens only.
products.form.collectionsDescription: Only collections belonging to the selected season are shown.
products.form.noCollections: No collections are available for the selected season.
products.form.specificationsDescription: Add up to 50 bilingual specification rows.
products.validation.requiredNames: Arabic and English names are required.
products.validation.positivePrice: Price must be greater than zero.
products.validation.invalidSlug: Use lowercase English letters, numbers, and single hyphens only.
products.validation.currentPriceTooHigh: Current price cannot exceed original price.
products.validation.maxSpecifications: A product can have at most 50 specifications.
products.validation.duplicateArabicSpeci: Arabic specification names must be unique.
products.validation.duplicateEnglishSpec: English specification names must be unique.
products.details.title: Product Details
products.details.description: View product content, catalog relationships, pricing, and inventory summary.
products.statusDialog.title: Publication Status
products.statusDialog.description: Control product visibility and featured placement.
products.statusDialog.publishedDescripti: Publishing requires valid active references and at least one available variant.
products.statusDialog.featuredDescriptio: Featured products must also be published.
products.deleteDialog.title: Delete Product
products.deleteDialog.description: This soft-deletes the product and removes it from publication and featured placement.
products.restoreDialog.title: Restore Product
products.restoreDialog.description: Restore this product as an unpublished catalog item.
products.options.title: Product Option Catalog
products.options.description: Manage reusable option definitions and their bilingual values for product variants.
products.options.dialogDescription: Configure the bilingual option name. Option type cannot be changed after creation.
products.options.typeImmutable: The backend does not allow changing an option type after creation.
products.options.empty: No product options have been created.
products.options.valueDescription: Enter the Arabic and English display values.
products.variants.title: Product Variants & Stock
products.variants.description: Create option combinations, control availability, and update stock with concurrency protection.
products.variants.createDescription: Select at most one value per option. SKU is generated by the backend.
products.variants.defaultVariantHint: No options are required. Create a default variant with an empty option combination.
products.variants.structureLocked: Available variants must use the same option structure; the current structure has been locked.
products.variants.stockDescription: Update stock for {{sku}} using its latest concurrency token.
products.images.title: Product Images
products.images.description: Manage the general gallery and color-specific galleries, primary images, and display order.
products.images.rules: JPEG, PNG, or WebP only. Maximum file size is 10 MB. Color galleries are available after color variants exist.
products.errors.notFound: The product could not be found.
products.errors.duplicateSlug: Another product already uses this slug.
products.errors.cannotPublish: The product does not meet the publication requirements.
products.errors.invalidReference: One or more catalog references are invalid or inactive.
products.errors.inconsistentOptionStruct: Available variants must all use the same option structure.
products.errors.stockConcurrency: Stock changed elsewhere. Reopen the dialog and try again with the latest value.
products.errors.unknown: The operation could not be completed.
